views.title: Wonderland
views.attribution: Drawn for Fable after Lewis Carroll (tools/draw_map.py)

places.name: The rabbit-hole
places.note: The hole under the hedge that the White Rabbit pops down; it drops like a very deep well.

places.name: Long hall
places.label: The Long Hall
places.note: A long, low hall lit by a row of lamps, with locked doors all round.

places.name: Little door
places.label: The Little Door
places.note: A door about fifteen inches high, behind a curtain in the hall, opening on a passage to a garden.

places.name: Pool of tears
places.label: The Pool of Tears
places.note: The pool Alice wept when she was nine feet high.

places.name: The shore
places.note: Where the swimmers in the pool of tears scramble out to get dry.

places.name: Neat little house
places.label: The White Rabbit's House
places.note: The White Rabbit's house, with a bright brass plate on the door.

places.name: Thick wood
places.label: The Thick Wood
places.note: The wood Alice runs into from the Rabbit's house.

places.name: Large mushroom
places.label: The Caterpillar's Mushroom
places.note: A mushroom about Alice's height, growing in the wood.

places.name: Large kitchen
places.label: The Duchess's House
places.note: The Duchess's house, a little house about four feet high in an open place in the wood; its door leads into a smoky kitchen.

places.name: House of the March Hare
places.note: A house with chimneys shaped like ears and a roof thatched with fur.

places.name: The tea-party
places.label: The Mad Tea-Party
places.note: A table set out under a tree in front of the March Hare's house.

places.name: Beautiful garden
places.label: The Beautiful Garden
places.note: The garden Alice glimpses through the little door: bright flowers and cool fountains.

places.name: The rose-tree
places.note: A large rose-tree near the entrance of the garden.

places.name: Ledge of rock
places.label: The Mock Turtle's Rock
places.note: Where the Mock Turtle sits, sad and lonely.

places.name: Bottom of the sea
places.label: The Bottom of the Sea
places.note: The sea where the Mock Turtle went to school.

places.name: Court of justice
places.label: The Court of Justice
places.note: The court where the King and Queen of Hearts sit on their throne.
